output_a_inspection_review_queue.disclaimer: STAGE 4 RESEARCH DISCLAIMER: The Inspection Review Queue provides an evidence-weighted ranking of visual defect findings strictly to prioritize human inspector site visits and verification. It does NOT assert official structural risk, repair deadlines, maintenance work orders, structural failure probabilities, or certified AASHTO bridge element condition ratings.

priority_decision.abstention_reason: ENGINEERING MAINTENANCE PRIORITY ABSTENTION: Actionable bridge maintenance priority, repair work orders, and statutory condition states CANNOT be determined from 2D optical computer vision detections alone. Official engineering prioritization strictly requires: (1) verified structural component identity and load path criticality, (2) physical metric dimensions and internal defect depth from calibrated NDT tools, (3) documented historical progression rates, and (4) formal approval by a licensed Professional Engineer (PE/SE) under agency-adopted maintenance decision criteria. Consequently, official maintenance priority is marked NOT_ASSESSED.
